Special Branch
DIST: 9986
27 H Ho

"A"
Misc. 400/40. Central
Apr. 26th, 40.

1.
2p.m. - 2.30p.m. 128 Museum Road.
26-4-40.

Re threat of violence.

Complainant, one Walter Cohn, German Refugee, Manager
of "WACO", 128 Museum Road Room 631, reported to the
Station at 2p.m. 26-4-40 that his foreman, named Yau Kai
Ching (姚启清) had threatened his staff, 9 Chinese
workmen, to beat them up, would they continue to work in
complainant's factory.

Enquiries made by D.S. Krader and C.D.C. 209
revealed that the complainant had dismissed the accused
at 9a.m. even date, owing to his inefficiency in the
work.

However, the accused who did not want to leave,
requested the other workmen to stop their work in sign
of protest for his dismissal.

The staff thus afraid did not dare to take up their
duty in the afternoon, in this way causing the complainant
considerable damage to the effect that urgent orders
could not be executed.

At 2.15p.m. even date all the workmen were taken
to the station and questioned, however the accused
promised to leave his job without further trouble.

He was released and the others again took up their
work in the factory.

Forwarded for information.

（印：INDEXED (S.B.) DATE 29 / 4 / 40）
（左侧边缘有模糊印章及手写字迹，难以辨认）

Duncan
Asst. Supt. I/C. 26/4

D. S.

特别处
分发号：9986
27 H Ho

“A”
杂项 400/40。中央
1940年4月26日。

1.
下午2时 - 下午2时30分。博物馆路128号。
1940年4月26日。

关于暴力威胁事宜。

报案人沃尔特·科恩（Walter Cohn），德籍难民，“WACO”公司经理，住址博物馆路128号631室，于1940年4月26日下午2时向警局报案称，其领班姚启清（Yau Kai Ching）威胁其员工，即9名中国工人，若继续在其工厂工作，便将殴打他们。

经警佐克拉德（Krader）及刑事侦缉处209号探员调查查明，报案人因被指控者工作效率低下，已于当日早上9时将其解雇。

然而，被指控者不愿离职，要求其他工人停止工作，以抗议对其解雇。

员工们因此感到恐惧，不敢在下午复工，致使报案人遭受相当损失，导致紧急订单无法执行。

当日下午2时15分，所有工人均被带至警局接受讯问，但被指控者承诺不再滋事并离开工作岗位。

随后将其释放，其他人则回厂复工。

呈报供参考。

（印：已归档 (特别处) 日期 1940年4月29日）
（左侧边缘有模糊印章及手写字迹，难以辨认）

邓肯
助理督察长 主管 1940年4月26日

D. S.
